content.title: Convert Camera RAW to JPG Online
content.p1: Developed for photographers, this tool allows you to convert uncompressed RAW images from major camera brands (Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fuji, etc.) into widely supported JPG files.
content.p2: RAW files contain unprocessed data from the sensor and are huge. Converting them to JPG applies standard processing (like white balance and color profile) to make them viewable and shareable.

formats.title: All Major Formats
formats.desc: Supports CR2 (Canon), NEF (Nikon), ARW (Sony), DNG (Adobe), and many more.

quality.title: High Quality
quality.desc: Uses advanced algorithms to essentially 'develop' your digital negative into a beautiful image.

how_to.title: How to Convert RAW to JPG
list: Select your RAW file from your computer.
The tool will upload and process the file.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: A RAW file contains minimally processed data from a digital camera sensor. It's like a digital film negative.
faq.a2: RAW files are very large (often 20MB+) and require complex processing to turn raw sensor data into a visible image.
